benchmark: fresh held-out expert-aware Cross + all-pair F2L
scramble_generator: 25 random outer turns; excludes training/reconstruction and previous reported evaluation scrambles

mode_definitions.planner_original: Historical hierarchical policy and original 72-action normalization.
mode_definitions.planner_legal: Planner action distribution renormalized over legal outer turns.
mode_definitions.legacy_expert_action_only: Original reco.nz action model through a canonical feature adapter; planner value and pair selector.
mode_definitions.expert_action_only: New human-only canonical action policy; planner value and pair selector.
mode_definitions.fused: Validation-calibrated log-probability fusion; planner value and pair selector.
mode_definitions.expert_pair_order: Planner action policy and expert-only human pair-order selector.
mode_definitions.combined: Validation-calibrated action fusion plus expert-only pair-order selector.
mode_definitions.uniform_action: Uniform legal action branch ordering, other planner heads retained.
mode_definitions.execution_cost: Planner plus exhaustive pair-order selection by STM; move-count proxy only, not human speed.

execution_metrics: STM/HTM and rotation counts are simulator move counts; TPS, recognition, pauses, fingertricks and human ratings not measured
deterministic_reference: comparison only; never called from neural inference
